all_completion_and_external_effects_reso.mechanism: the build manifest receipts the generator, every input and every output by content hash; verification recomputes all of them from the live repository, an unreceipted file in the output is refused, and a re-sealed forgery still fails because the expected bytes are re-derived from the inputs

governing_schemas_authority_boundaries_f.mechanism: the emitted documents keep exact field sets with recomputable hashes; backend_name and license come from the canonical schema consts rather than restatement; and the readiness map must cover every required field of shinka-backend-manifest.schema.json exactly, each blocked field carrying the reason it cannot be pinned yet

happy_negative_crash_resume_adversarial_.mechanism: two emits are byte-identical, the committed output equals what the tracked inputs produce, a deleted or corrupted output is refused then repaired byte-identically, and every weakened pin — unpinned artifacts, drifted floors, unlocked or smuggled dependencies, tampered registry counts — is refused with a typed code

no_candidate_model_prompt_backend_or_hoo.mechanism: the Shinka profile is emitted DISABLED and UNQUALIFIED with every EF4-I63 authority flag false; a profile edited toward enablement, qualification, authority or an install extra is refused at verification with the code that names the attempt, because no sealed B06/T06 qualification exists
